top_signals.title: Stocks Gain in Wake of Fed
top_signals.summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger and David Gura on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Stocks push higher after the Fed’s unanimous rate hike under Kevin Warsh. President Trump threatens new tariffs on Europe as the EU deepens ties with Canada. Lucid CEO Silvio Napoli joins us on the company’s major self-driving deal with Bolt. Plus, Clearlake takes full control of Chelsea Football Club. And Interparfums CEO Jean Madar and Dynex Capital Co-CEO Smriti Popenoe join us on tariffs, consumers and the housing market. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: A Body Blow? The War on Iran and U.S. Military Readiness
